messages:
Aisha: Heads up — we're out of #2 paper filters and only one kombucha left in the fridge. Anyone heading out who can grab filters and a 6-pack? Also the Tupperware pile is getting dangerous. :sweat_smile:
Drew: I can swing by Whole Brew in ~20. Which filters? #2 paper, right? Also non-dairy milk preference? oat or almond?
Aisha: yes #2. Oat is preferred (2L). And thanks!! :heart:
Sam: I'll bring croissants from Little Oven on my way in at 10 if someone can do the kombucha. Also can we start a sticky on the shelf 'Leftovers — claim in 3 days'?
Priya: Put me down for kombucha (Ginger+Lime) and I’ll label Tupperware tonight. Also can we add 'no mystery containers older than 2 weeks' sign? :laughing:
KitchenBot: Snack Fund: $28.50 remaining. Quick reminder: to top up, send Venmo to @redwood-kitchen or drop cash in the jar. :coins:
Aisha: New mini checklist for whoever goes: ```- 1 box #2 paper filters
- 2L Oat milk
- 6-pack Ginger+Lime kombucha
- 1 pack napkins
- Optional: butter croissants```
Drew: grabbing everything except croissants ok? I'll swing by Little Oven too if Sam needs backup.
Sam: Nah you got it, I already ordered. ETA 10:15. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup: 
Priya: I'll stick labels on the top shelf + take a photo after. Can someone toss the half-empty jar of salsa? It's been... there a while.
Aisha: Please don't throw without asking — but if unlabeled >2 weeks we can compost. Thanks y'all :raised_hands:
